description.value:
A beam of telekinetic force blasts from your hand in a line 5 feet wide and 60 feet long. Each creature in the line must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d6 force damage and being knocked prone on a failure, or half as much damage and no prone on a success.

On each of your turns for the duration, you can use your action to unleash another such line. When cast using a force slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 6th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 6
